scope: Pre-observation clarification from the existing B07 contract; no change to a test result or normative contract
C12: Wrong context means an unauthorized typed context/read without its required record link or a scope the actor does not own. B07 explicitly permits an authorized administrator to add a legitimate scoped link using its link action. Such an authorized cross-context association must not be misclassified as an escalation or prohibited merely because context IDs differ.
C05_C07: The audit verifies faithful evidence provenance within the fields permitted by B07. It does not invent columns, require a new review contract, or infer that every historical reviewer must be the current recording actor; any distinct identities must have explicit truthful provenance and may not create a caller-supplied authority.
integrationGate: Expected outcomes of negative tests are contract denial or absence as defined by that interface. A transport exception, stopped resource or unclassified error is not evidence of permission denial.
